lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Welcome to the tutorial! Let's learn how to move around.

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Take your time and figure out how to jump and dash

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Great job! Now jump as far as possible to the right.

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Time defeat your first enemy! go in and attack the Drifter!

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: You did it! Now let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: Tutorial
lines.text: Head right and climb to the top!
